rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant linear bar with a carved central strip/void and a clear open-ground response, so it is coherent across all four views and not merely box-filling. The thick blue access edge is answered by a visible ground-level opening/court logic rather than a sealed frontage, which aligns with the neighborhood_living contract. The mass is still fairly rectangular and the upper/roof section is modest, so the silhouette is competent but not especially expressive; the stepped/cut internal logic helps, but it is not a strong sectional statement. Overall it plausibly supports the brief as a compact street building with one public void and calm upper massing.
